subject: Exciting Job Opportunity at ABC Company
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am pleased to inform you about an exciting job opportunity at ABC Company for the position of Marketing Specialist. Your qualifications and experience make you an ideal candidate for this role. If you are interested, please reply to this email with your updated resume attached. We look forward to potentially welcoming you to our team! Best regards, [Your Name] HR Manager
